title: validation messages brief no end punctuation
rule: Validation messages brief; no end punctuation unless multiple sentences.
pass_when: Brief validation; no end punctuation on a single sentence; punctuation only if multiple sentences.
fail_when: Single-sentence validation with a trailing period, or long un-brief validation.
overview: Fluent validation copy stays brief and omits end punctuation on one sentence.
apply_when: Writing Fluent field validation messages after input fails checks.
not_when: Multi-sentence help text under the field — that is helper-text guidance.
agent_hint: Keep validation brief; no trailing period on a single sentence.
description: Fluent validation messages stay brief so the fix is scannable beside the field. A single sentence takes no end punctuation; add punctuation only when the message needs multiple sentences. Apply when writing Fluent field validation after input fails checks, not multi-sentence helper text. Fail single-sentence validation with a trailing period, or long un-brief validation copy.
